senses.gloss: pr. n. pl.Modaim, Modim, Modin, the native place of the Asmonean family. [Eds. a. Mss. vary between מוֹדָע׳, מוֹדִיע׳ a. מוֹדִיעִית.] Kidd. 66ᵃ.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 93b:11">Ib. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>מן המ׳ ולירושלם וכ׳</he> from M. to Jerusalem are fifteen miles.

<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 3:5">Ḥag. III, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Chagigah 3:33">Tosef. ib. III, 33</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="M00419"><he>מודעים</he></cite>, <cite ref="Eruvin 54b:25">Erub. 54ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M00411"><he>מוֹדִיעַ</he></cite>.]
